_meta.source: Hand-compiled: AI-image galleries and prompt pages that publish generated images with their prompt or model
_meta.note: intake.py suffix-matches these hosts against the reverse-search result links (links[].url, similar[].from). A host alone only down-weights: open the page and compare. Stock sites (Adobe Stock, Freepik, Shutterstock) sell real photos too and are never tagged by host.
